messageHandlers.script:
# Ticket Logger context-menu opener
	# page-scoped: every view on the page hears it - only the view whose menu was clicked acts
	sender = payload.get('sender')
	if sender and sender != self.view.id:
		return
	shared.Alerts.contextMenuTicketLog(payload['tagPath'], payload['viewName'])

config.script:
# Custom report builder, pre-filled from this dashboard (scope / shift / day)
	sel = self.view.custom.selectedUnit or ''
	shared.Reports.open('production', {
		'scope': ['unit:' + sel] if sel else ['line'],
		'shifts': [self.view.custom.shiftSel] if self.view.custom.shiftSel else [],
		'dayOffset': self.view.custom.dayOffset or 0,
		'origin': 'Production Overview',
	})

legend.formatter: function(seriesName, opts){var s=opts.w.globals.series||[];var t=0;for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){t+=s[i];}var v=s[opts.seriesIndex]||0;var p=t>0?Math.round(v/t*1000)/10:0;return seriesName + '  ' + p + '%';}
